\textbf{No credit will be given unless you show your work.} This quiz
will count as two homework grades. 

\emph{Solve the following equations.}
\begin{enumerate}[resume]
\item $4(x+4)=6(x-2)$\vfill
\item $\frac{3x}{4}-4=1-\frac{7x}{8}$\vfill
\item $5|4x-5|-3=9$\vfill
\item $\frac{1}{F}=\frac{1}{v}+\frac{1}{n}$ for $n$.\vfill
\item $B=\frac{1}{9}t(f-s)$ for $f$.\vfill\newpage
\end{enumerate}
\emph{Solve the following equation; identify the equation as an identity,
inconsistent, or conditional equation; and determine for which values
the equation is undefined.}
\begin{enumerate}[resume]
\item $\frac{9y}{y+1}=7-\frac{9}{y+1}$\vfill
\end{enumerate}
\emph{Solve the following word problems}
\begin{enumerate}[resume]
\item Farmer John is going to fence off a lot and then cross-fence to divide
it into four smaller lots. If he has 516 feet of fencing, how much
area will be fenced?\vfill
\item How many liters of a 70\% alcohol solution must be mixed with a 50
liter solution that is 30\% alcohol to get a mixture that is 50\%
alcohol. \vfill
\item James can grade a pile of 30 quizzes in 2 hours. It takes Catherine
1 hour to grade the same stack of quizzes. If they work together,
how long will it take to grade the quizzes?\vfill\newpage
\end{enumerate}
\emph{Perform the indicated operation(s).}
\begin{enumerate}[resume]
